content: Bash i18n without gettext is a well-known but informally documented pattern: source a strings/<lang>.sh file defining MSG_* variables with fallback to a default-language file ('source strings/en.sh || true; source strings/.sh 2>/dev/null || source strings/en.sh'), or bash-4 associative arrays as label maps (declare -A MSG). Community documentation is sparse (Linux Journal covers the gettext route; Slackware howto covers testing; TRANSTEXT as a historic gettext alternative). Pattern is MEDIUM confidence community wisdom, not a spec.
